name: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell vLLM: openai/gpt-oss-20b aggregate output throughput, 1000 requests
methodology: Database Mart vLLM bench on one RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 48 GB GDDR7 ECC (Server Edition, not the 72 GB workstation SKU). Model openai/gpt-oss-20b, quantization column '16' (bf16/fp16 not distinguished; format_id null, no fp16 record exists). vLLM commit not printed. Single GPU, tensor parallel 1. 1000 requests, input length 100 tokens, output length 600 tokens, benchmark duration 196.12 s, total input tokens 100000, total generated tokens 414552. AGGREGATE across the concurrent requests, not a per-request decode rate.
notes: Output (tokens/s) column. Aggregate across 1000 requests, not the per-request eval rate.
